visual.general_description: Color photograph of a printed 12-lead electrocardiogram on pink gridded paper.
visual.detailed_description: A photographed ECG strip sheet with a pink grid. Lead labels I, II, III, aVR, aVL, aVF, V1, V2, V3, V4, V5 and V6 are printed beside their tracings, and the label III appears twice (a lower strip). The upper limb-lead tracings are low in amplitude with an uneven baseline. The precordial tracings differ in amplitude; the V3 tracing is larger and more irregular than the others and V4 contains a short blue-tinted segment. A white band crosses the sheet between the limb and precordial leads with faint printed paper text. The photograph is slightly skewed with uneven lighting. No printed rate, interval, axis, speed, gain, patient identifier or date is legible.

visual.general_description: Composite of eight grayscale axial chest CT images with contrast enhancement.
visual.detailed_description: Eight axial chest CT tiles in two groups without printed panel letters. The upper group (four tiles in two rows) shows the heart with a very bright, contrast-filled right-sided chamber and the lungs dark, with a dense region in the left posterior hemithorax and the spine at the bottom centre; tiles have thin white borders and a faint small bracketed letter marker (P) at the lower edge of some tiles. The lower group (four tiles in two rows) uses a soft-tissue window: the ascending aorta and pulmonary trunk are bright, the right pulmonary artery region shows a bright vessel with irregular darker material inside it, and a large homogeneous soft-tissue-density area fills the left lower hemithorax. Ribs, vertebra and table edge are visible. No other text, arrows, scale, measurements or patient identifiers are legible, and the tiles do not state which time point each represents.

visual.general_description: Color photograph of two printed ECG sheets (limb leads above, precordial leads below) with printed device text.
visual.detailed_description: Two photographed ECG sheets with a pink grid. The upper sheet shows leads I, II, III, aVR, aVL and aVF with a calibration pulse at the left; the lower sheet shows V1 to V6. Printed text includes the machine name and version, a hospital-equipment brand line, a speed and gain line ("Auto 25mm/s 10mm/mV"), a filter setting, a printed date and time stamp, a printed rate "102BPM" at the lower left and a filter value near it, and manufacturer text on the paper edge. The tracings show regularly spaced complexes with visible upright and inverted deflections that vary by lead; a short blue-tinted segment appears at the right end of aVF and V5. The photograph is slightly skewed.
